name: Cement And Gypsum Products SAOG

description: Cement and Gypsum Products SAOG, founded in April 2000 in Al Buraimi and listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange in January 2002, was established to manufacture and supply cement and gypsum construction materials in Oman. The issuer is classified on the MSX Under_Monitoring Market in long-standing inactive status, with no financial statements or corporate disclosures recorded on MSX since its March 2011 AGM/EGM resolutions and FY2009 audited accounts. With OMR 1.50 million paid-up capital across 1.50 million shares and 423 registered shareholders, the stock currently shows zero active market capitalization and no regular trading.
